facts.text: The Buff Promise covers fall and spring in-state tuition for undergraduate Texas residents whose annual family income is $80,000 or less.

sources.title: Buff Promise | WTAMU
sources.quote: West Texas A&M University has committed 100% of its available resources to cover fall and spring in-state tuition for undergraduate Texas residents who have an annual family income of $80,000—the median income level for our region—or less.
